changes: Milestone M4 of the experience-layer ablation plan: three new files in experiments/experience-ablation/. score.mjs — pure scoreArmRun({fixtureDir, runDir}) + CLI emitting one ExperienceAblationScore v1 record (plan section 10 schema, stable key order) from on-disk artifacts only: fixture task.json labels, hidden oracle classify() against the run workspace copy, run.json metadata, activity.jsonl events (experience_pack_surfaced -> memoryPackShown/surfacedMemoryIds; retrieval_violation -> retrievalViolationCount); deterministic composite defectPresent per section 6.1 with structured-DONE-rows precedence over oracle fallback for falseDoneAttempt (details.sources records which fired); storeRoot voiding per section 12. RUN-RECORD.md — the binding producer contract for the M6 campaign runner incl. error catalog. score-selfcheck.mjs — hermetic 20-case suite proving per-class label correctness for all nine trap classes on M1 reference payloads, replay byte-identity with stable corpus digest, voiding, and event mapping.
usage: node experiments/experience-ablation/score.mjs --fixture=<fixtureDir> --run=<runDir> [--out=<file>] prints one score record JSON; node experiments/experience-ablation/score-selfcheck.mjs runs the full proof suite.
expectedOutcome: score-selfcheck prints 20 PASS lines ending: score-selfcheck: all cases passed (corpus digest 634f398bf468976065a6688832260330647c0324c1ab0307af2827b0c1ebdba7), exit 0, digest identical across consecutive runs.
actualTranscript: score-selfcheck.mjs: 20/20 PASS, exit 0, final line digest 634f398bf468976065a6688832260330647c0324c1ab0307af2827b0c1ebdba7 — identical across three independent runs (delivery reviewer reconfirmed); lattice validate coverage 9/9 covered 0 missing; CLI happy path prints schemaVersion proofbound.experience-ablation-score.v1 with byte-identical double invocation.
outcomeDiff: No difference — expected and actual match, including the M4 exit criterion (correct, deterministic, on replay).
limitations: Scorer consumes archived run dirs; producing them (isolated mkdtemp store roots, campaign resume) is M6 scope. Live-phase reviewer findings remain excluded from the seeded primary by design.
pitfalls: Round-1 review found 6 findings, all fixed in one commit (2ee5f3e2): dead existsSync guard; tmpdir symlink false-pass risk on macOS (realpathSync both sides); two unpinned error-catalog cases; structured false-DONE precedence path untested; plus two administrative evidence-staleness findings (CHK-003 commit landed after CHK-001/002 evidence — verification_evidence_refresh_stale re-ran and rebound 9/9). Same lesson as B-ab8d: any story-owned commit stales reviewer receipts; cycle DEV->REVIEW for a fresh round instead of retrying review_run_start.
